title: Firstpass hero storyboard and modular frames for Quickstart landing
creator: Elena Park
description: Design a compact, modular hero and first-run storyboard system for the Quickstart landing page that scales across breakpoints and supports A/B testing. Deliverables: a hero hero-frame library (3 compositional variants), a 4-step storyboard sequence (motion + static export), responsive screenshot templates (mobile/tablet/desktop), and production-ready exports with tokens and handoff notes for engineering. Focus: clear entry path for new users, minimal cognitive load, and strong visual hierarchy while preserving Redwood brand tone (developer-first, pragmatic, technical polish).
acceptance_criteria: Three hero composition variants exported as static SVG and PNG (centered-compact, split-action, and contextual-illustration)
Four-step first-run storyboard exported as MP4 (micro-animation) and static frames (1200x620, 768x480, 360x640)
Responsive screenshot templates with device masks and copy overlays for 3 breakpoints, ready for engineering to swap content via CMS
Figma file annotated with tokens (spacing, colors, type scale) and a single-page handoff guide in Confluence with naming conventions and export settings
Accessibility checks: 4.5:1 contrast on CTA, button tap targets >=44px, semantic alt-text for non-decorative images
Design review approval from PM (Jonah Kim) and Engineering lead for Console (Priyanka Singh)
All final assets uploaded to Drive under /Design/Quickstart/2026-04 and linked in ticket
